metadata.phase: TDD Red Phase 2 — Orchestration Unit Tests
metadata.subject_under_test: EcosystemScanOrchestrator (to be implemented in enhancement Step 9)

distinction_from_step7_atdd.step7_atdd_scope: End-to-end acceptance tests exercising EcosystemScanOrchestrator.run_scan() with real Step 6 caches and fixture-driven dep lists (23 acceptance tests).
distinction_from_step7_atdd.step8_red_scope: Unit tests on orchestrator internals: constructor wiring, helper method call order, state machine transitions, error propagation, serializer dispatch — every injected dep mocked via MagicMock(spec=...) for type-strict mocking.

tested_components: EcosystemScanOrchestrator._emit_state (implicit via state machine transition asserts)
out_of_scope: Business-logic correctness of EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper (covered by Step 5)
OSVCache / GHSACache file-loading behaviour (covered by Step 5)
End-to-end SBOM byte-equality across runs (covered by Step 7 ATDD)
Parent ScanOrchestrator internals (not modified by this enhancement)

test_classes.focus: Dependency injection, attribute storage, lazy construction guarantees
run_scan() pipeline call order, mock invocation counts, exception propagation
How the orchestrator injects its three caches into the ecosystem mapper
CycloneDX / SPDX serializer selection, cpe_sanitize configuration, duck typing
Reuse of parent WorkflowStateMachine, state transitions, exception path state recording
Parent ScanOrchestrator regression, CLIOrchestrator integration, ScanResult contract preservation

totals.expected_outcome_on_first_run: ALL 51 TESTS FAIL (Red Phase) — Step 9 enhancement orchestrator does not exist yet

red_phase_verification._note: Errors arise from fixtures calling pytest.fail() inside _require_orchestrator() when step9_tdd_green_phase_orchestration.py is absent in the enhancement directory. Errors and failures are both valid Red-phase signals — pytest treats both as non-passing for the build.

tolerance_design.constructor_shape: Tests use _build_rich_orchestrator() which first tries the rich Pattern-A constructor (tool_runner, adapters, deduplicator, ecosystem_mapper, remediation_enricher, vex_filter, serializers, workflow_state_machine, caches) and falls back to the Step-7-ATDD signature (nvd_cache, osv_cache, ghsa_cache, tool_runner) if Step 9 implemented the simpler form.
tolerance_design.attribute_names: Where the orchestrator could plausibly expose a dep under several attribute names (e.g. workflow_state_machine vs state_machine), tests probe ALL canonical spellings before failing.
tolerance_design.subclass_vs_compose: Test 1.9 (inheritance check) xfails (does not break the build) when Pattern B (subclass) is used — Pattern A (composition) is preferred but Pattern B is acceptable.
tolerance_design.case_insensitive_format: Test 4.7 xfails for non-canonical case if the orchestrator chose strict case-sensitive dispatch.

spec_based_mocks: MagicMock(spec=OSVCache) for OSV cache fixtures (rejects calls outside the real interface)
behavioural_mocks: Tool runner: callable mock returning a Syft-shaped dict (built from step1b mixed_repo_deps fixture)
Adapters: dict of MagicMocks exposing normalise()
Serializers: dict of MagicMocks exposing serialize() and a cpe_sanitize attribute (preset True)
Workflow state machine: side_effect tracks transitions to a local list, exposes visited_states()
mocking_strategy._no_live_network_note: Per CI guarantee in step1_requirements.constraints.technical.no_live_network_in_ci — zero outbound network calls from the test module or any fixture.

spec_contracts: Workflow state names taken directly from parent ScanWorkflowState enum
Exception class names taken directly from Step 6 (OSVCacheNotSyncedError, GHSACacheNotSyncedError) and parent module (NVDSyncError)
Output format identifiers ('cyclonedx', 'spdx') are spec contracts

expected_step9_contract.preferred_constructor_signature: EcosystemScanOrchestrator(tool_runner, adapters, deduplicator, ecosystem_mapper, remediation_enricher, vex_filter, serializers, workflow_state_machine, caches, logger=None, fallback_orchestrator=None)
expected_step9_contract.return_type_contract: Parent ScanResult dataclass (dependencies, active_vulns, suppressed_vulns, warnings, sbom_document, workflow_states_visited, scan_id, repo_name, output_format)

constraints_honoured: Did not implement the orchestrator (Step 9's job)
Did not modify any parent session file
Did not use live network in tests or fixtures
